title: Investigation of DNA Degradation Patterns in Tissue Using FTA™ Cards
author: Yatry Krushnalal Patel

steps.title: Prepare tissue samples for storage
steps.instruction: Cut a slice of beef tissue on a ceramic tile, assign one tile to be stored outside and one inside, and keep them for the designated time points of 6 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 week, and 1 day.

substeps.instruction: Cut a slice of beef tissue on a ceramic tile.
Place one tile outside and one tile inside.
Store the tiles for 6 weeks, 3 weeks, 1 week, and 1 day.

steps.title: Punch tissue onto FTA card
steps.instruction: Moisten a 6 mm punch with 1 µL TE buffer, position it over the tissue on the FTA card, apply a 0.8 kg weight for 5–10 s using UV‑sterilized parafilm between punch and weight (discard after use), then leave the tissue on the card for 24 h.

substeps.instruction: Moisten the punch with 1 µL TE buffer.
Position the punch over the tissue on the FTA card.
Apply a 0.8 kg weight for 5–10 seconds.
Place UV‑sterilized parafilm between the punch and the weight; discard parafilm after use.
Leave the tissue on the card for 24 hours.

steps.title: Cut 6 mm punch from Elute card
steps.instruction: Place the QIAcard FTA Elute card on a cutting mat, cut a single 6 mm punch, and transfer the punch into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

substeps.instruction: Place the QIAcard FTA Elute card on a cutting mat.
Cut one 6 mm punch from the card.
Transfer the punch into a 2 mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Wash punches with TE buffer
steps.instruction: Perform 2–3 washes of the punches with 500 µL TE buffer, vortexing briefly, centrifuging to remove excess liquid, and discarding the supernatant; process samples in sets of two as indicated.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 500 µL TE buffer into the tube containing the punch.
Vortex for 5 seconds, ensuring the punches move to the centre of the tube.
Briefly centrifuge to collect excess liquid on the cap.
Remove and discard the excess TE buffer.
Repeat the above wash steps for a total of two to three washes (process samples in batches of two).

steps.title: Digest punches with Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL QIAcard FTA Elute Buffer and 6 µL Proteinase K to the tube, then incubate at 60 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm for 25 minutes.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 100 µL FTA Elute Buffer and 6 µL Proteinase K into the tube containing the washed punch.
Place the tube on a heated mixer or shaker set to 60 °C, 1000 rpm, for 25 minutes.

steps.title: Inactivate Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Heat the tube at 95 °C with shaking at 1000 rpm for 5 minutes to inactivate Proteinase K.

substeps.instruction: Place the tube on a heated mixer or shaker set to 95 °C, 1000 rpm, for 5 minutes.

steps.title: Final spin and discard punches
steps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge to remove excess liquid, then spin at maximum speed for 2 minutes; discard the punches before downstream quantification or amplification.

substeps.instruction: Briefly centrifuge the tube to remove any excess liquid from the cap.
Spin at maximum speed for 2 minutes.
Discard the punches.

steps.title: Prepare 25 µL PCR mix
steps.instruction: Prepare a 25 µL PCR reaction mixture as required for downstream amplification.

steps.title: Prepare 1.2 % agarose gel
steps.instruction: Make a 1.2 % agarose gel using 0.8 g agarose and 60 mL 1× TBE buffer, melt, cool to 60 °C, add SYBR™ Safe stain, pour, and allow to set.

substeps.instruction: Weigh 0.8 g agarose powder into a suitable container (e.g., Erlenmeyer flask).
Add 60 mL 1× TBE electrophoresis buffer (do not swirl).
Place the flask on a hotplate and heat to boiling, swirling occasionally.
After boiling, let the solution cool to 60 °C.
Add 6 µL SYBR™ Safe DNA Gel Stain and swirl to mix.
Pour the mixture into the electrophoresis casting tray.
Allow the gel to set for 20–30 minutes.

steps.title: Load samples and run electrophoresis
steps.instruction: Mix PCR product with loading dye, load 10 µL into gel wells, run at 150 V for 30 minutes, and capture an image of the gel.

substeps.instruction: In a new tube, add 2 µL 5× loading dye to 10 µL PCR product.
Pipet up and down to mix.
Load 10 µL of the mixture into each well of the gel.
Run the gel at 150 V for 30 minutes.
Capture the gel image using a gel documentation system.
